optimization_unit.name: Exact-V8 all-five attained-profit floor protection
optimization_unit.question: Can one complete all-five map of causal attained-profit floors reduce peak-to-close giveback and drawdown while retaining temporal and whole stressed value, without changing any exact-V8 entry opportunity?
optimization_unit.mechanism_boundary: Only an already accepted and open exact-V8 position may be affected. Once its mark profit first reaches a frozen activation multiple of its admitted planned risk, the mechanism may tighten that position's broker stop to a fixed nonnegative retained-profit multiple of the same admitted risk.

input_staging_boundary.rule: No input copy, config, proxy implementation, candidate economic row or code candidate may be created until this declaration commit is verified on origin/main.

this_unit_is_limited_to: A shared all-five planned-risk-R activation threshold
A shared all-five nonnegative fixed retained-profit floor below activation
Coarse map, fine adjacency, one-component causal ablations, fresh validation, temporal/cost stability and a conditional scarce native pair
optimization_scope.new_entry_strategy_definition: Any new symbol, timeframe, signal family, direction or opportunity timestamp not emitted by exact V8, or any entry loosening that manufactures an opportunity.

exact_v8_fixed_contract.stop_merge_rule_for_later_native_candida: Never loosen the broker/native/pending stop. If both RC64 adverse compression and profit-floor protection are valid, request only the directionally more protective executable stop.

partial_identification_contract.certain_trigger: Activation is reached and either peak_time is before close with last_mark_r <= floor_r, or peak_time is before a globally timestamped trough at or before close with trough_mark_r <= floor_r.
partial_identification_contract.certain_never: Activation is never reached, or the global lifecycle trough remains strictly above the floor.
partial_identification_contract.ambiguous: Every other lifecycle; neither a first crossing nor a noncrossing may be asserted.
partial_identification_contract.certain_never_book: Use the exact native actual/stressed amount.
partial_identification_contract.ambiguous_lower_book: Per economic book use min(native amount, floor amount), denying beneficial unidentified triggers while charging harmful unidentified triggers.
partial_identification_contract.ambiguous_upper_book: Per economic book use max(native amount, floor amount) for diagnostic width only; upper books never select, rank, rescue or advance a role.
partial_identification_contract.closed_balance_dd_upper_bound_timing: For the lower book, any negative replacement is charged at source birth and any nonnegative replacement remains at the native close. Native/unchanged outcomes stay at native close. This adverse ordering alone supplies selection DD and minimum balance.
partial_identification_contract.risk_occupancy: Retain the exact native open interval and planned-risk occupancy through native close for every role.
partial_identification_contract.source_volume_and_ladder_feedback: Retain exact source volumes and source accepted lifecycle set. Do not synthesize balance-driven future lot changes.
native_claims_withheld: Exact first-crossing order and execution time

neutral_role.meaning: Exact V8 with no new profit floor

ordered_deep_stages.coordinate_rule: Include every activation/floor pair with floor_r < activation_r and activation_r - floor_r >= 0.10R.

eligibility.common: Every development half-year lower-bound book has positive actual net, positive stressed net and positive minimum balance.
eligibility.primary: Continuous development lower-bound stressed net retains at least 75% of exact-V8 development stressed net and adverse-timing actual closed-balance DD is no more than 27%.
eligibility.fallback: Continuous development lower-bound stressed net retains at least 65% of exact-V8 development stressed net and adverse-timing actual DD improves by at least five percentage points versus exact V8.
eligibility.identification: At least 20 certain triggers total, at least four active components and at least four development/validation-era blocks before holdout economics. Ambiguous events never satisfy density.
eligibility.robustness: An eligible nonneutral role needs at least two eligible immediate coarse neighbors collectively spanning both activation and floor axes.

ordered_deep_stages.center_selection: Use primary if nonempty, otherwise fallback. Rank robust roles by highest weakest development-half lower-bound stressed net, lower-bound stressed-net-to-DD efficiency, lower-bound stressed net, lower DD, narrower upper-lower identification width and canonical coordinates. Select at most three separated coordinate pairs.
ordered_deep_stages.no_robust_fallback: Advance up to three separated declared near misses by normalized common/retention/DD/identification deficits, then lower-bound efficiency and canonical coordinates. This preserves mandatory depth but is not economic confirmation.

ordered_deep_stages.local_activation_rule: For each center A use unique max(0.15,A-0.10), A and min(0.85,A+0.10).
ordered_deep_stages.local_floor_rule: For each center F use unique max(0,F-0.05), F and min(0.35,F+0.05), then retain only F < A with at least 0.10R separation.
ordered_deep_stages.deduplication: Deduplicate exact A/F pairs across centers while retaining provenance.
ordered_deep_stages.eligibility_and_ranking: Stage-A lower-bound common, primary, fallback, identification, robustness, ranking and near-miss rules remain unchanged; immediate fine neighbors differ by one local coordinate step.

ordered_deep_stages.roles_per_center: One unchanged all-five center plus five diagnostics that disable only RC61, RC64, Cross, Intraday or Return profit-floor protection while leaving native exits and the other four protections unchanged.
ordered_deep_stages.ablation_selection_rule: No ablation may replace, retune or rescue its immutable center.
ordered_deep_stages.fresh_validation_gate: The immutable center lower-bound book begins from fresh $100 and must have positive actual net, positive stressed net, positive minimum balance, adverse-timing DD no greater than 30%, stressed retention at least 65% of exact V8, and the frozen identification density.
ordered_deep_stages.causal_nondominance_gate: The center fails if any one-component native-exit ablation has lower-bound stressed net at least as high and DD no higher, with at least one strict difference beyond 1e-9.

ordered_deep_stages.block_gate: Every block begins independently at $100. Its lower-bound actual/stressed net and minimum balance must be positive and adverse-timing actual DD no greater than 30%.
ordered_deep_stages.identification_gate: Across the continuous path, certain triggers must cover at least five of six blocks and at least four of five active components; ambiguous events receive no density credit.
ordered_deep_stages.whole_gate: Continuous 2024-01 through 2026-07 lower-bound replay must retain at least 75% of exact-V8 stressed net and improve adverse-timing actual closed-balance DD by at least five percentage points.
ordered_deep_stages.ranking: Maximize weakest block lower-bound stressed net, then whole lower-bound stressed-net-to-DD efficiency, whole lower-bound stressed net, lower DD, narrower identification width and canonical coordinates. Locked holdout never selects an alternate.
ordered_deep_stages.empty_input_rule: If Stage C has zero authorized immutable centers, record all blocks as zero-input/zero-run and close U004 validly empty without an ablation, neighbor or near miss.

ordered_deep_stages.conditional: Exactly one unchanged Stage-D winner may enter.

ordered_deep_stages.purpose: Establish exact first crossings, broker stop execution and quantization, early capacity admissions, balance/lot feedback, native open-equity DD and complete economic numbers.
ordered_deep_stages.authority: A native result can support or close U004 but cannot modify or promote Live directly.

closure_and_correction_rules.economic_closure: Only after Stages A through D are completed as declared and no unchanged Stage-D survivor exists, or after the sole valid Stage-E finalist nonconfirms with no declared layer remaining.
closure_and_correction_rules.required_after_closure: Freeze the whole Unit bundle, then recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 before opening any successor.
